headline: Canada's Fairfax, led by Prem Watsa, takes control of Goody's and Everest
summary: Vivartia Holding announced a definitive agreement for the sale of 100% of the shares in Recipe, owned by Fairfax. The Newpost report also says Canada's Fairfax, led by Prem Watsa, takes control of Goody's and Everest.
why: Fairfax Financial is a Toronto-based insurance and investment holding company, and deals like this reshape ownership of Greek food and restaurant businesses.
